event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Chips led, defensives bled.
October durable goods printed 1.8% vs 1.7% fc and Conference Board confidence jumped to 91.7 vs 81 fc, but the tape's engine was VRT +16.48% on $4.313B net sales vs $3.77B est and ORCL +10.73% on Investor Day, powering SOXX +2.13% and QQQ +0.60% while RSP fell -0.04%. That is mega-cap earnings leadership, not broad risk appetite — participation stayed flat (246/256 adv/dec) and QQQ traded at 0.8x volume into tomorrow's core PCE 3.10% fc.

INDICES — VIX 16.9, just above its 16.8 20-day MA. SOXX +2.13% > QQQ +0.60% > IWM +0.40% > SPY +0.34% > DIA +0.27%. Large beat small by just 0.20pp — the cap-weighted tape was not a size story. Notable cross-asset move: TLT -0.78% as long-end yields backed up; USO +1.64% on the crude draw (EIA -1892k vs +1.5k fc).

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY 0.8x and QQQ 0.8x: volume fell as price rose — a low-conviction, earnings-driven rally, not accumulation. Gaining attention: SLV 1.2x and GLD 1.2x (silver skew 36.2% IV), FDN 1.8x, TAN 1.8x into a -2.48% decline (distribution). Breadth diverges: 58% above 50DMA, 57% above 200DMA, up/down volume 0.98, 30 new highs vs 23 lows — flat internals against green indices = narrow mega-cap tape.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK Technology +0.80%, XLF Financials +0.45%, XLE Energy +0.35%, XLI Industrials +0.34%, XLV Healthcare +0.30%, XLB Materials +0.15%, XLY Discretionary -0.10%, XLP Staples -0.36%, XLC Comms -0.42%, XLRE Real Estate -0.73%, XLU Utilities -0.84%. Top industries: DRAM +7.13%, WGMI +4.90%; bottom: CIBR -1.58%, TAN -2.48%. Flows contradict the price rank: XLP drew +$413mm (90p) and XLK +$392mm (79p) while XLU bled -$883mm (0p) and XLF -$806mm (15p) despite positive returns — leaders losing money, laggards buying. Money is in semis (SOXX +$5,326mm, 100p) and out of small caps (IWM -$2,446mm, 8p), so the durable rotation is AI hardware versus everything else. Label: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.54 shows heavy downside protection demand while QQQ PCR 0.39 is outright complacency; QQQ skew +10.4% is the widest on the board. QQQ spot sits near its 725 gamma flip (max pain 714), so dealer hedging amplifies moves on any break below. VIXEQ 41.8 vs VIX 16.9 is a ~25-point gap — high single-stock dispersion, a rotation tape, not a macro one.

CROSS-ASSET — Crude drew -1892k vs +1.5k fc and USO +1.64%, yet XLE only +0.35% and XLU -0.84% — energy equities lagging the commodity. Gold +0.33% with the dollar -0.21% (UUP) is a clean inverse-dollar bid, but GLD has bled -$2,243mm (2p) over 5 days. Next FOMC Dec 9: Polymarket has 25bp hike at 78% YES and no-change 18% YES.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 57.8, Neutral. Movers: VRT +16.48% on the revenue beat, ORCL +10.73% on Investor Day, BSX -5.84% on cut Q4 sales/guidance (vol 4.6x), ODFL -7.33% (2.8x). Vol spikes: VRT 3.3x up with price = accumulation; BSX 4.6x down = distribution. Momentum: XLE best 20d at +11.30%, XLC worst at -7.06%. Watch: QQQ (spot near 725 gamma flip), GLD (-2p flows vs positive price — divergence worth resolving), SLV (1.2x vol, 36.2% IV, still -25.38% ytd).
